confidence_notes: Cardiff price surveys support the meal, cappuccino and beer estimates. Cocktail and 175 mL house wine estimates use local beer prices and limited drink observations. Lodging is modeled for typical July nights outside major events, with the greatest uncertainty for private hostel rooms and basic guesthouses. [Numbeo](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Cardiff), [Average Cost of Living](https://www.averagecostof.living/in/united-kingdom/cardiff/restaurants/), [Expatistan](https://www.expatistan.com/cost-of-living/cardiff), [PubWatch UK](https://pubwatchuk.co.uk/wales/venue/cardiff--zero-degrees--w95037872)
comparable_city_reasoning: Bristol provides a nearby reference for budget and mid-range lodging in a regional UK city with summer weekend demand.
